column1: # kind  name  key  description  flags
mode    containers  -  containers, running first                         default
mode    images      -  images (dangling ones dim)                        -
mode    volumes     -  volumes (unused ones dim)                         -
mode    networks    -  networks                                          -
mode    compose     -  compose projects                                  -
toggle  running     alt-a  containers: only running ones                 -
sort    state       -      containers: running first                     default
sort    created     -      images: newest first                          -
sort    name        -      containers, images: by name                   -
sort    size        -      images: largest first                         -
action  start       alt-s   start containers / compose up -d             reload
action  stop        ctrl-x  stop containers / compose down               reload
action  restart     alt-R   restart containers / compose restart         reload
action  kill        -       kill containers (SIGKILL)                    confirm,reload
action  remove      alt-x   remove containers, images, volumes or networks (forced)  confirm,reload
action  exec        alt-e   a shell in the container (zsh, bash, ash, sh)  foreground
action  logs        ctrl-l  follow the logs, several merged (ctrl-c returns) / compose logs  foreground
action  inspect     alt-i   docker inspect in the pager                  foreground
action  run         -       images: docker run (options and command asked; default a shell, this directory at /work)  foreground
action  pull        -       images and compose projects: pull            foreground,reload
action  prune       -       remove dangling images, unused volumes or networks, stopped containers  confirm,reload
